description: This file contains utility functions and templates for reduction operations in the ATen/native namespace of PyTorch. It defines functions for bounds checking, tensor reshaping, reduction shape calculation, and tensor iteration helpers used in reduction-based tensor operations.

methods.name: scalar_t upper_bound()
methods.description: Returns the maximum finite value (or infinity) for the specified scalar type.

methods.name: scalar_t lower_bound()
methods.description: Returns the minimum finite value (or negative infinity) for the specified scalar type.

methods.name: Tensor restride_dim(const Tensor & src,int64_t dim,IntArrayRef replacement_shape)
methods.description: Returns a tensor with the specified dimension's stride set to zero, effectively reshaping for broadcasting or reduction.

methods.name: void _dimreduce_setup(const Tensor & result,const Tensor & self,int64_t dim)
methods.description: Prepares the result tensor shape for a reduction operation along a specific dimension.

methods.name: bool _dimreduce_return_trivial(const Tensor & result,const Tensor & self,const Scalar & ident,int64_t dim,bool keepdim)
methods.description: Handles trivial reduction cases when input tensor is a singleton or empty.

methods.name: bool _dimreduce_return_trivial_no_ident(Tensor & result,const Tensor & self,int64_t,bool,const char *)
methods.description: Handles trivial reduction cases without a default identity value.

methods.name: std::optional<Tensor> _allreduce_return_trivial(const Tensor & self,const Scalar & ident)
methods.description: Returns a tensor filled with the identity value if the input tensor is empty.

methods.name: void check_scalar_type_device_layout_equal(const Tensor & out,const Tensor & self)
methods.description: Ensures that two tensors have matching scalar type, device, and layout.

methods.name: Tensor integer_upcast(const Tensor & self,std::optional<ScalarType> dtype)
methods.description: Converts an integer tensor to a higher precision type if needed.

methods.name: DimVector make_dim_vector(OptionalIntArrayRef opt_dims,int64_t ndim)
methods.description: Creates a vector of dimensions based on optional input or defaults to all dimensions.

methods.name: DimMask make_dim_mask(OptionalIntArrayRef opt_dims,int64_t ndim,bool allow_empty_dims=false)
methods.description: Creates a mask for selected tensor dimensions.

methods.name: DimVector shape_from_dim_mask(const Tensor & self,DimMask mask,bool keepdim)
methods.description: Computes the shape of a tensor after reduction based on mask and keepdim flag.

methods.name: void resize_reduction_result(Tensor & result,const Tensor & self,DimMask mask,bool keepdim,ScalarType)
methods.description: Resizes the result tensor to match the shape of the reduction output.

methods.name: Tensor create_reduction_result(const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef dim,bool keepdim,ScalarType dtype)
methods.description: Creates an output tensor for reduction, with proper shape and dtype.

methods.name: Tensor review_reduce_result(const Tensor & result,int ndim,DimMask mask,bool keepdim)
methods.description: Adjusts the shape of the reduction tensor result to match whether keepdim is used.

methods.name: TensorIterator make_reduction(const char * name,Tensor & result,const Tensor & self,at::OptionalIntArrayRef dim,bool keepdim,ScalarType out_dtype)
methods.description: Constructs a TensorIterator configured for a reduction operation, taking into account dtype promotion.

methods.name: void zero_numel_check_dims(const Tensor & self,const IntArrayRef dim,const char * fn_name)
methods.description: Verifies that reduction dimensions are valid for zero-element tensors.

methods.name: std::vector<int64_t> get_zero_numel_tensor_size(const Tensor & self,const int64_t dim,const bool keepdim,const char * fn_name)
methods.description: Determines the size of an output tensor when reducing a tensor with zero elements.

methods.name: void zero_numel_tensor_resize(Tensor & result,Tensor & result_indices,const Tensor & self,const int64_t dim,const bool keepdim,const char * fn_name)
methods.description: Resizes the output tensors when the input tensor has zero elements, based on reduction dimensions.

methods.name: ScalarType get_dtype_from_self(const Tensor & self,const std::optional<ScalarType> & dtype,bool promote_integers)
methods.description: Determines the appropriate data type for a tensor operation, with optional promotion.

methods.name: ScalarType get_dtype_from_result(Tensor & result,std::optional<ScalarType> dtype)
methods.description: Gets the data type from a result tensor or from specified dtype.
